recommendation: Keep this commit as the current-core preservation of FHIR-47271. A separate follow-up may be warranted to repair or publish the API Incubator async detail links, but this seed does not require reintroducing the deleted pages.
issue_request: FHIR-47271 was Applied/Persuasive and asked that the async pages make clear which pattern is triggered by Prefer: respond-async when _outputFormat is present, including what happens for values other than application/fhir+ndjson. The resolution states that, for servers supporting both Bulk Data and Asynchronous Interaction patterns, _outputFormat disambiguates the two and selects Bulk Data when present; servers supporting only Bulk Data may make _outputFormat optional.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#3192 merged on 2024-11-12 and included commit 61b36bd16f37afdeb9f955f00f7ad896dde86012, which applied the rule to source/async-bulk.html and source/async-bundle.html. Those local detail pages were later deleted by commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd, so the original application no longer appeared in current core source.
additional_context: Current core source keeps source/async.html as the active asynchronous request patterns overview and links to API Incubator detail pages. The current CI async overview is reachable, but the linked API Incubator async-bulk and async-bundle URLs return 404, leaving the approved clarification unavailable from current core output. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-10-07 record the persuasive vote and related discussion; Jira provides the precise _outputFormat rule.
reconciliation: Added the approved disambiguation to source/async.html: _outputFormat selects the Bulk Data pattern when both patterns are supported for the same request type; _outputFormat may be optional when only Bulk Data is supported; and a request with _outputFormat returns an error and OperationOutcome when Bulk Data is not supported for that request type.
source_changes: source/async.html: Added an active overview paragraph preserving the approved _outputFormat disambiguation and error behavior for choosing between Bulk Data and Asynchronous Interaction async patterns.
